Interior rectangular loaded area, full perimeter, uniform depth, zero transferred moment, no critical opening,

effective depth require their own current action/section assessment. One-way shear, flexure, deformation
and full connection approval remain separate. Complete rectangular critical perimeter at mean effective
depth/2 from loaded-area faces; no beneficial membrane stress or shear reinforcement credit.
